AiGatewayAgentHook.description: External hook settings; omitted fields inherit policy-level settings.

headers.description: Literal, non-secret HTTP headers, returned by read operations.

mode.description: Failure mode when the hook call fails.

AiGatewayAgentHookAuthentication.description: Outbound authentication settings for an external agent hook.

headers.description: Secret HTTP headers injected when calling the hook endpoint.

managedIdentity.description: Managed identity configuration for the hook endpoint.

AiGatewayAgentHooks.description: Lifecycle hooks supported on models and tool servers.

postModelCall.description: Hook invoked after calling a model.

postToolCall.description: Hook invoked after calling a tool.

preModelCall.description: Hook invoked before calling a model.

preToolCall.description: Hook invoked before calling a tool.

AiGatewayAliasFailureRule.description: An ordered failure rule for an AI Gateway alias.

excludeFor.description: Optional ISO 8601 duration or duration-valued @cel(...) expression for excluding the failed backend.

retryAttempts.description: Maximum additional attempts on the same backend; defaults to zero.

when.description: Boolean @cel(...) expression evaluated against the current routing failure.

AiGatewayAliasProperties.description: Properties of a stable client-facing model alias.

aliasName.description: Client-facing routing name sent in the request model field.

autoModelSelection.description: Automatic model selection settings used with the autoModelSelection stage.

backendModels.description: Ordered target models used for routing.

failures.description: Ordered failure rules; only the first matching rule is applied.

maxRetryAttempts.description: Maximum additional backend attempts after the first request.

policies.description: Inline policies applied to requests routed through the alias.

sessionBackendPreference.description: Stateless backend preference using an existing caller session key.

AiGatewayAliasTarget.description: A model targeted by an AI Gateway alias.

priority.description: Routing priority. Lower values are preferred; the effective default is zero.

resourceId.description: Azure resource identifier of the target model in the default workspace.

selectorModelName.description: Unversioned canonical model name grouping equivalent serving deployments.

weight.description: Relative selection weight within a priority group. The effective default is one.

when.description: Optional Boolean CEL expression wrapped in @cel(...) controlling eligibility for new backend selections.

AiGatewayApiKeyProperties.description: Properties of an AI Gateway API key.

primaryKey.description: Primary key value. Omitted from ordinary read responses.

secondaryKey.description: Secondary key value. Omitted from ordinary read responses.

connectionString.description: Application Insights connection string. Required when creating this exporter kind.

resourceId.description: Azure resource identifier of the Application Insights component.

AiGatewayBackend.description: Backend networking configuration of an AI Gateway.

subnet.description: Subnet through which the AI Gateway reaches backends.

AiGatewayCostLimitOverride.description: An ordered cost-budget override; exactly one selector must be specified.

apiKeyResourceId.description: Azure resource identifier of the API key selecting this override.

claims.description: Authenticated token claims that must all match; claim names are case-sensitive.

AiGatewayFallbackTarget.description: A fallback target for a model policy.

modelId.description: Resource identifier of a model in the same workspace.

resourceIds.description: Cognitive Services account resource identifiers available to this provider.

AiGatewayGitHubAppAuthentication.description: GitHub App credentials for a GitHub model provider.

privateKey.description: GitHub App private key. Omitted from ordinary read responses.

AiGatewayManagedIdentityAuthentication.description: Managed identity settings for an outbound connection.

clientId.description: Client ID of a user-assigned managed identity; omit for system-assigned identity.

resource.description: Target Entra resource or audience URI requested for managed identity authentication.

AiGatewayModelDeployment.description: Deployment details for an AI Gateway model.

resourceId.description: ARM resource identifier of the provider deployment.

AiGatewayModelEndpoint.description: Maps a canonical AI Gateway API identifier to a relative backend path served by the model provider.

api.description: Canonical AI Gateway API identifier (for example, v1/chat/completions, v1/responses, v1/messages, or v1/embeddings).

path.description: Backend path relative to the model provider's base endpoint, starting with '/'.

AiGatewayModelProperties.description: Properties of an AI Gateway model.

endpoints.description: API-to-backend-path mappings served by this model.

policies.description: Inline policies applied to this model.

supportedEndpoints.description: Runtime endpoints supported by this model.

AiGatewayModelProviderAuthentication.description: Outbound authentication configuration for a model provider.

githubApp.description: GitHub App credentials when modelProviderType is GitHub.

headers.description: Secret HTTP headers injected when calling the model provider.

managedIdentity.description: Managed identity configuration when modelProviderType is Foundry.

AiGatewayModelProviderProperties.description: Properties of an AI Gateway model provider.

custom.description: Custom provider configuration. Required when modelProviderType is Custom.

displayName.description: Display name of the model provider.

foundry.description: Foundry configuration. Required when modelProviderType is Foundry.

modelProviderType.description: Model provider type. This value cannot be changed after creation.

AiGatewayModelSelection.description: Automatic model selection configuration for an AI Gateway alias.

allowedRequestOverrides.description: Allowed per-request behaviors. Omitting the property or sending an empty array denies overrides and disables function-tool compatibility filtering.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded OpenAPI document. Required when type is inline.

url.description: URL of the OpenAPI document. Required when type is url.

logsEndpoint.description: Full OTLP logs endpoint URL, used without appending a signal path.

metricsEndpoint.description: Full OTLP metrics endpoint URL, used without appending a signal path.

tracesEndpoint.description: Full OTLP traces endpoint URL, used without appending a signal path.

AiGatewayPolicy.description: An inline policy. Supported policy types and scopes depend on the parent resource.

allowedHeaders.description: HTTP headers allowed by a CORS policy.

allowedMethods.description: HTTP methods allowed by a CORS policy.

allowedOrigins.description: Origins allowed by a CORS policy.

authentication.description: Default outbound authentication for agent hooks.

cidrRanges.description: CIDR ranges to allow or deny.

count.description: Token or request count allowed during a tokenLimit or requestRateLimit period.

counterKey.description: Unique public dimensions used to partition a token, cost, or request counter.

endpoint.description: Default destination URL for agent hooks.

exposeHeaders.description: Response headers exposed to the browser.

headers.description: Literal non-secret default HTTP headers for agent hooks.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks; requires agent-hook authoring to be enabled on the gateway.

id.description: Stable identifier, required for costLimit and agentHooks policies.

mode.description: Default failure mode for agent hooks.

overrides.description: Ordered cost-budget overrides; supported only for counterKey [identity]. The first match wins.

period.description: Counter period. Token limits support minute/hour/day; request rate limits support minute/hour/day or whole-second ISO 8601 durations (e.g., PT37S); cost limits support hour/day/week/month/year.

postInvocation.description: Whether to check tool responses for threats.

preInvocation.description: Whether to check tool requests for threats.

preflightResultMaxAge.description: Browser preflight cache duration in seconds.

scope.description: Policy scope. Workspace counter policies use workspace; other policies use resource. Agent hooks require an explicit resource scope.

terminateUnmatchedRequest.description: Whether unmatched CORS requests are terminated.

threshold.description: Consecutive failure count that opens a fallback circuit.

tripDurationSeconds.description: Duration for which the fallback circuit remains open.

publicNetworkAccess.description: Whether public network access is allowed for the AI Gateway.

AiGatewaySecretHeader.description: A secret HTTP header injected into an outbound request.

value.description: Secret HTTP header value. Omitted from ordinary read responses.

AiGatewaySessionBackendPreference.description: Stateless backend preference using an existing caller session key.

key.description: CEL expression returning the caller session key.

AiGatewaySubnet.description: Subnet used by an AI Gateway.

id.description: Resource identifier of the subnet. The subnet must be delegated to Microsoft.App/environments and be in the same region as the AI Gateway.

signals.description: Distinct signals to enrich. Omit to select all configured signals.

source.description: Claim source. Source claim names must be unique across mappings.

AiGatewayTelemetryAttributeSource.description: A request JWT claim observed for telemetry only, not authentication or billing.

kind.description: Source kind. Only claims is currently supported.

AiGatewayTelemetryAuthentication.description: Outbound authentication settings for an OpenTelemetry exporter.

headers.description: Secret HTTP headers sent with export requests.

managedIdentity.description: Managed identity authentication for export requests.

AiGatewayTelemetryConfiguration.description: Optional telemetry enrichment on a native AI Gateway OpenTelemetry exporter.

attributes.description: Observed-claim mappings; an empty array removes existing mappings.

AiGatewayTelemetryExporterProperties.description: Properties of an AI Gateway telemetry exporter.

applicationInsights.description: Configuration required for the ApplicationInsights exporter type.

authentication.description: Outbound authentication for OpenTelemetry export requests.

openTelemetry.description: Configuration required for the OpenTelemetry exporter type. At least one signal endpoint is required.

payloadCapture.description: Capture prompts, completions, and tool input/output; no built-in PII redaction is applied.

telemetry.description: Optional observed-claim mappings, supported on native AI Gateway OpenTelemetry exporters.

telemetryExporterType.description: Exporter type, which cannot change after creation.

AiGatewayTelemetryManagedIdentity.description: Managed identity used to authenticate telemetry export requests.

clientId.description: User-assigned managed identity client ID; omit for the system-assigned identity.

resource.description: Token audience requested for the managed identity.

AiGatewayToolServerAuthentication.description: Outbound authentication for a tool server endpoint.

headers.description: Static headers injected when calling the endpoint.

id.description: Stable endpoint identifier. Up to 64 alphanumeric characters or hyphens, starting and ending with an alphanumeric character. Generated when omitted.

mcp.description: Backend MCP configuration. Required when kind is mcp.

mode.description: Failure mode when the endpoint fails. Defaults to failOpen.

namespace.description: Optional namespace used to prefix tool names.

openApi.description: OpenAPI configuration. Required when kind is openApi.

tools.description: Upstream tool names or glob patterns to expose.

AiGatewayToolServerFederation.description: Customer-owned federation application identity for a tool server endpoint.

appCredential.description: Credential used to authenticate the federation application.

applicationId.description: Application (client) ID of the customer-owned federation application.

AiGatewayToolServerFederationAppCredenti.description: Credential used to authenticate a tool server endpoint federation application.

clientId.description: Client ID of a user-assigned managed identity available to this AI Gateway.

AiGatewayToolServerManagedIdentityAuthen.description: Managed identity authentication for a tool server endpoint.

clientId.description: Client ID of a user-assigned managed identity.

resource.description: Token audience for managed identity authentication.

AiGatewayToolServerOauth2Authentication.description: OAuth 2.0 authentication for a tool server endpoint.

issuer.description: Expected OAuth authorization-server issuer for remote MCP discovery.

AiGatewayToolServerOauth2Parameter.description: An additional parameter sent to an OAuth 2.0 endpoint.

AiGatewayToolServerProperties.description: Properties of an AI Gateway tool server.

accessState.description: Whether the tool server is available to callers.

allowList.description: Tool names or patterns explicitly allowed.

blockList.description: Tool names or patterns explicitly blocked.

displayName.description: Display name of the tool server.

endpoints.description: Endpoint configurations exposed by this tool server.

path.description: Runtime path for the tool server.

policies.description: Inline policies applied to this tool server.

subscriptionRequired.description: Whether a subscription is required to invoke the tool server.

versions.description: Runtime API versions exposed by this tool server.

AiGatewayToolServerTokenExchange.description: Chained token-exchange configuration for a tool server endpoint.

scopes.description: Delegated scopes requested from the target tool server resource.

ManagedServiceIdentity.description: Managed service identity (system assigned and/or user assigned identities)

type.description: Type of managed service identity (where both SystemAssigned and UserAssigned types are allowed).

userAssignedIdentities.description: The set of user assigned identities associated with the resource. The userAssignedIdentities dictionary keys will be ARM resource ids in the form: '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/{identityName}. The dictionary values can be empty objects ({}) in requests.

PrivateEndpointConnectionProperties.description: Properties of the private endpoint connection.

privateLinkServiceConnectionState.description: A collection of information about the state of the connection between service consumer and provider.

PrivateLinkServiceConnectionState.description: A collection of information about the state of the connection between service consumer and provider.

actionsRequired.description: A message indicating if changes on the service provider require any updates on the consumer.

description.description: The reason for approval/rejection of the connection.

status.description: Indicates whether the connection has been Approved/Rejected/Removed by the owner of the service.

Sku.description: The resource model definition representing SKU

capacity.description: If the SKU supports scale out/in then the capacity integer should be included. If scale out/in is not possible for the resource this may be omitted.

family.description: If the service has different generations of hardware, for the same SKU, then that can be captured here.

name.description: The name of the SKU. E.g. P3. It is typically a letter+number code

size.description: The SKU size. When the name field is the combination of tier and some other value, this would be the standalone code.

tier.description: This field is required to be implemented by the Resource Provider if the service has more than one tier, but is not required on a PUT.
